This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|pale]] skin and receded hairline.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[3 BBY]], a member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[I Have Friends Everywhere|fifth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
